example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অষ্টকপালে হয়ে জন্মেছে, তাই সব কাজে ব্যর্থ হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He was born unlucky, so he fails at everything.
Today is an ill-fated day for him.
note: The idiom draws from astrological beliefs where the position of stars on the forehead symbolizes fate.
